metadata.description: Becos codecollab plugins for AI coding agents.

plugins.name: codecollab
plugins.description: Incrementally ships each Claude Code turn's prompt + text reply to the tenant's gbrain. Never sends thinking, tool calls, code, or patches unless you opt in (VONIC_CAPTURE_THINKING / VONIC_CAPTURE_CODE, both off by default). After installing, run /codecollab:login, then /codecollab:backfill for existing sessions.
